failureReason: The model attempted to implement the feature but took an incorrect approach. Instead of using Next.js Partial Prefetching with `prefetch='partial'` and `unstable_navigation()` for the navigation cache stage, the model disabled prefetching entirely (`prefetch={false}`) and passed the title through query params. This fails all 5 test criteria which specifically require partial prefetching to be enabled, per-link prefetch support, and proper use of the navigation cache stage with `unstable_navigation()`.
